Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

softcats 1.0.0

  • First CRAN release.
  • soft_lm() estimates the effects of a latent categorical group from calibrated class probabilities, with cross-fitted nuisance functions, repeated sample splitting, weights and cluster-robust standard errors.
  • Learners: lrn_ranger() (default), lrn_lm(), lrn_glmnet() and lrn_custom(), with separate learners for the outcome and the score regressions.
  • Diagnostics: score_spectrum(), calibration_check(), exclusion_test(), drift_sensitivity(), compare_hard(), kappa_curve() and the combined report soft_check().
  • recalibrate() recalibrates the class probabilities on labelled data, checks the recalibrated probabilities out of fold and recomputes the estimate; its predict() method recalibrates other data.
  • Methods for print(), summary(), coef(), vcov(), confint(), nobs(), formula(), residuals(), fitted() and plot(), and for the tidy() and glance() generics used by broom and modelsummary.
  • sim_softcats() simulates data with calibrated probabilities and known effects.

Developed by Marcell T. Kurbucz, Economic and Social Research Council.
